items.exampleEn: The little boy was in ecstasy when he opened the gift.
items.exampleZh: 小男孩打開禮物時欣喜若狂。

items.exampleEn: The terrified cat ran up a tree.
items.exampleZh: 那隻嚇壞的貓爬到了樹上。

items.exampleEn: My mom was horrified by the mess in the kitchen.
items.exampleZh: 媽媽看到廚房亂成一團，大驚失色。

items.exampleEn: He wrote a humorous story about his cat.
items.exampleZh: 他寫了一篇關於他的貓的幽默故事。

items.exampleEn: The player was unfairly sent off the field.
items.exampleZh: 那名球員被不公平地罰出場。

items.exampleEn: She is too vain to wear her old glasses.
items.exampleZh: 她太愛面子，不肯戴舊眼鏡。
items.glossZh: 自負的；愛慕虛榮的；徒勞的

items.exampleEn: My uncle always cooks hearty soup in winter.
items.exampleZh: 我舅舅冬天總會煮分量十足的湯。

items.exampleEn: I scolded myself for forgetting my keys again.
items.exampleZh: 我責怪自己又忘了帶鑰匙。

items.sentenceEn: Don't scold the dog; it didn't mean to.
items.sentenceZh: 別罵那隻狗，牠不是故意的。

items.audioEn: My little sister was terrified during the storm. She hid under her bed all night.
items.audioZh: 暴風雨時我妹妹嚇壞了，整晚都躲在床底下。
items.questionZh: 妹妹在暴風雨時怎麼了？

items.sentenceEn: The children were terrified of the dark.
He gave me a hearty welcome.

items.stemEn: Her ____ speech made the whole room laugh.
items.stemZh: 她幽默的演講讓全場都笑了。

items.stemEn: The teacher ____ the boys for fighting in the hall.
items.stemZh: 老師責罵那些男孩在走廊上打架。

items.passageEn: Last month, my friends and I went to an amusement park. First, we had a hearty lunch. Then we walked into a dark house full of fake ghosts. My friend Leo was terrified and held my arm the whole time. A fake monster jumped out and horrified a little girl. Later, we watched a humorous show. When some people won prizes, the crowd screamed in ecstasy. Leo is a bit vain, so he checked his hair in every mirror. We got home late, and my mom was angry. I felt she scolded me unfairly, because I had told her we would be late.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我和朋友們去了一座遊樂園。首先，我們吃了一頓豐盛的午餐。接著我們走進一間黑漆漆、到處都是假鬼的屋子。我朋友 Leo 嚇壞了，整路都抓著我的手臂。一個假怪物跳出來，把一個小女孩嚇得驚恐萬分。後來，我們看了一場幽默的表演。有人贏得獎品時，群眾欣喜若狂地尖叫。Leo 有點自負，每經過一面鏡子都要看看自己的頭髮。我們很晚才到家，媽媽很生氣。我覺得她罵我罵得不公平，因為我早就跟她說過我們會晚回家。

questions.questionZh: 作者為什麼覺得媽媽不公平？
options: 因為作者早就說過會晚回家
笑得太大聲，被工作人員請了出去
嚇壞了，一直抓著作者的手臂
